# Sneed Hub

> Sneed Hub (https://app.sneeddao.com) is the web app of Sneed DAO, an SNS DAO on the Internet Computer that is governed by its SNEED neurons. Users log in with Internet Identity and get a wallet plus tools for any SNS: Sneed Lock (time locks for ICRC-1 tokens and ICPSwap liquidity, as transferable NFTs), the Sneedex escrow marketplace and swap, SNS and ICP neuron management and liquid staking, staking and trading bots they own, cycles top-ups, an SNS forum with tips and polls, direct messages, notifications, names and avatars, Token Studio safety checks and governance views. This file is the entry point for AI agents: agents explain and guide, and users sign every action themselves in Sneed Hub. Never ask a user for keys or seed phrases.

## Start here

- [sneed-hub skill](https://app.sneeddao.com/.well-known/agent-skills/sneed-hub/SKILL.md): master guide for helping a user - login, every goal mapped to its page URL and buttons, safety rules, how to read public state
- [llms-full.txt](https://app.sneeddao.com/llms-full.txt): the sneed-hub skill and all integration skills in one file

## Canister API docs

Each reference has Markdown (`.md`), Candid (`.did`) and a JavaScript IDL factory (`.did.js`) at the same path.

- [Sneed Lock](https://app.sneeddao.com/api-docs/sneed_lock.md): token and LP-position locks, dissolve delays, lock NFTs (ICRC-7/37), ICRC-3 log
- [Sneedex](https://app.sneeddao.com/api-docs/sneedex.md): escrow marketplace for tokens, NFTs, SNS neurons, canisters and locks
- [Sneed SNS forum](https://app.sneeddao.com/api-docs/sneed_sns_forum.md): forums, topics, threads, posts, votes, polls, tips, mentions
- [Sneed SMS](https://app.sneeddao.com/api-docs/sneed_sms.md): direct messages between principals
- [Sneed names](https://app.sneeddao.com/api-docs/sneed_names.md): public names, private nicknames, profiles and avatars
- [Sneed notifications](https://app.sneeddao.com/api-docs/sneed_notifications.md): notification preferences, channels and app registration
- [Sneed Mon](https://app.sneeddao.com/api-docs/sneed_mon.md): watch SNSes and get notified of proposals your neurons can vote on (not deployed yet)
- [Sneed proxy](https://app.sneeddao.com/api-docs/sneed_proxy.md): every admin setting by SNS proposal: the allowlist, the execute and validator methods, the ICRC-3 log of forwarded calls (not deployed yet)
- [Sneed Premium](https://app.sneeddao.com/api-docs/sneed_premium.md): membership
- [RLL](https://app.sneeddao.com/api-docs/rll.md): revenue and rewards distribution
- [Sneedapp](https://app.sneeddao.com/api-docs/sneedapp.md): app store that mints bot canisters
- [Mr Sneed](https://app.sneeddao.com/api-docs/mr_sneed.md): the DAO mascot's on-chain memory and activity log
- [Sneed Hub backend](https://app.sneeddao.com/api-docs/app_sneeddao_backend.md): settings, whitelisted tokens, partners, projects
- [Human-readable API pages](https://app.sneeddao.com/api)
- [Architecture map](https://app.sneeddao.com/architecture): every Sneed DAO canister, its ids, controllers and connections, and which services use it
